ModMetaData.name: Rimrooms - Async Industries
ModMetaData.author: Operator
ModMetaData.description:
Build an organization that investigates, contains, and profits from unstable spaces beyond a machine gate.
Development build 0.2.0: Async Industries starting facility, company account and staff, machine assembly and operation, saved AI-01 destination, field crew and cargo, route investigation, evidence analysis and Gate Telemetry. Includes original equipment and encounter artwork. Gameplay acceptance is pending; this is not a finished campaign release.
Designed for RimWorld 1.6. No DLC or Harmony required by this package. The full campaign, further scenarios, main-menu slideshow, RimWorld Together cooperation and optional integrations remain under development.
Author: Operator.
